create_KeypointMSELoss: create a KeypointMSELoss module to compute MSE loss on predicted heatmaps with optional target weights and masking
create_CombinedTargetMSELoss: create a CombinedTargetMSELoss module to compute MSE loss on combined classification and regression target heatmaps
create_KeypointOHKMMSELoss: create a KeypointOHKMMSELoss module to compute MSE loss with online hard keypoint mining keeping top k hardest keypoints
create_AdaptiveWingLoss: create an AdaptiveWingLoss module to compute adaptive wing loss for robust face alignment via heatmap regression
create_FocalHeatmapLoss: create a FocalHeatmapLoss module to compute modified focal loss for heatmap prediction using CornerNet style alpha and beta parameters
